FULL TEXT:
STENOGRAPHER RECRUITMENT EXAMINATION 2025
NOTICE
No.- 58/R&A Dated: 13th August, 2026
In continuation of this Court’s Notice No. 38/R&A dated 01.07.2026, whereby 08 (Eight) candidates
were granted extension of joining period till 29.07.2026 for joining to the post of Stenographer, it is
hereby notified that the following 03 candidates (details at Table-A) out of the aforesaid 08 (Eight)
candidates have neither submitted their joining to the aforesaid post nor prayed for any further
extension of joining time:
Table-A
Subsequently, on account of their non-joining as well as no prayers for further extension of joining
time, Hon’ble Court have been pleased to cancel their selection/appointment to the post of
Stenographer under Stenographer Recruitment Examination 2025.
By order of the Court
Sd/- Rupesh Deo
Registrar General
